# ChosenInlineResult

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.ChosenInlineResult`

```python
    *,

): ...
```

## Documentation

A [result](InlineQueryResult.md) of an inline query chosen by the user and sent to their chat partner.

> [!NOTE]
> In order to receive these updates, your bot must have "inline feedback" enabled. You can enable this feature
> with [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather).

### Parameters

- **`result_id`** (`str`)
  The unique identifier for the result that was chosen.

- **`from_user`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md))
  The user that chose the result.

- **`query`** (`str`)
  The query that was used to obtain the result.

- **`location`** ([`Location`](../messages_and_media/Location.md), *optional*)
  Sender location, only for bots that require user location.

- **`inline_message_id`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Identifier of the sent inline message.
  Available only if there is an [inline keyboard](../bots_and_keyboards/InlineKeyboardMarkup.md) attached to the message.
  Will be also received in [callback queries](../bots_and_keyboards/CallbackQuery.md) and can be used to edit the message.
